29:25.text: said, "You have only taken, other than Allāh, idols as
affection among you in worldly life. Then on the Day of Resurrection you will deny one another and curse one another, and your refuge will be the Fire, and you will not have any helpers."

29:26.text: my Lord. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise."

29:27.text: And We gave to him Isaac and Jacob and placed in his descendants prophethood and scripture. And We gave him his reward in this world, and indeed, he is in the Hereafter among the righteous.

29:28.text: Lot, when he said to his people, "Indeed, you commit such immorality as no one has preceded you with from among the worlds.

29:29.text: Indeed, you approach men and obstruct the road
evil." And the answer of his people was not but that they said, "Bring us the punishment of Allāh, if you should be of the truthful."

29:30.text: He said, "My Lord, support me against the corrupting people."
